Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Glenn Halberg <glennh2017@gmail.com>
Sent: Thursday, April 2, 2020 12:44 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Virtual games 
 
You’re a talented writer. It would be nice if your boss allowed you the freedom to use your talent. Fans are starving for interesting information to help make the time pass.

Sent from my iPhone
Glenn M. Halberg 
(248) 228-0395
On Apr 2, 2020, at 11:52 AM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:

Glenn, thanks for the e-mail and reading the Free Press. I don't call the shots here, I just do what I'm told. I'd much rather be writing about real baseball than broadcasting virtual baseball, I can tell you that. Hope all is well.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Glenn Halberg <glennh2017@gmail.com>
Sent: Thursday, April 2, 2020 10:22 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Virtual games 
 
Good morning,

This is the best you can do? Seriously?
How about a little creativity?
A couple of suggestions. Provide a summary of all of the other teams in the central division. What are their strengths and weaknesses.
Write a column about the rebuild status of other teams in comparison to that of the Tigers.
I’ve read some good articles from you. The virtual baseball stuff is horrible.

Sent from my iPhone
Glenn M. Halberg
